task: Implement and verify a Luhn checksum validator in Rust.
rules: Ignore ASCII spaces (' ') anywhere in the input string.
Return false if the cleaned string is empty or contains any non-ASCII-digit characters.
Double every second digit starting from the right; if doubled > 9, subtract 9.
Return true if and only if the sum of all processed digits modulo 10 equals 0.
Include thorough unit tests in src/lib.rs covering valid numbers, spaced numbers, invalid checksums, empty/whitespace strings, and non-digit characters.

qc_subagent.review_instructions: Audit both src/lib.rs (implementation AND unit tests) and README.md. Only output QC_VERIFIED_PASS if every item in the checklist passes completely; otherwise list the exact failures and output QC_FAILED.
checklist: Verify `pub fn is_valid_luhn(input: &str) -> bool` matches the exact signature and Luhn rules.
Verify zero `.unwrap()`, `.expect()`, or `panic!()` calls on user input.
Verify `src/lib.rs` includes a `#[cfg(test)]` module testing valid numbers, spaced numbers, bad checksums, empty/whitespace-only inputs, and non-digit characters.
Verify `README.md` exists, is clear, and includes a working Rust usage example.
